question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit between P and Q. N sits second to the left of P. L sits to the immediate left of N. M sits second to the left of L. M is not an immediate neighbour of Q. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
